MERGED. Gerrit change 1701 submitted at LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 with zero unresolved comments; merge sha c6828ef348 on main.

Acceptance criteria, all met:
- [x] Four legs reported with held/free/absent, and the mkdir leg carries host/ns/pid/start, liveness and hold age — asserted in test_a_live_holder_is_reported_but_is_not_a_finding and the JSON test.
- [x] Liveness is same-host only — test_a_foreign_host_holder_is_never_probed asserts 'unprobeable (foreign host)' and no pid guess.
- [x] Staleness comes only from lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale — the module has no independent age threshold and no independent pid probe deciding staleness; the only pid/age reads are descriptive fields.
- [x] Dead holder -> finding + exit 1 (test_doctor_exits_one_on_a_stale_lock); live holder -> no finding + exit 0 (test_doctor_json_carries_the_lock_report_and_stays_green_on_a_live_holder).
- [x] Doctor never mutates lock state — test_doctor_never_touches_a_lock runs both a plain pass and --repair over a stale lock and asserts the lock dir, owner file and drain lock file are unchanged.
- [x] JSON matches the updated schema (schema-coverage suite green) and the pinned help text documents the lock section, regenerated into docs/cli-reference.md.
- [x] Module-size cap respected: doctor_locks.py 384 LOC, doctor.py 332 LOC.
